best: The 3V3 buck and the USB four-switch power stage read as clean left-to-right textbook drawings with input caps, switches, inductor and output caps in order.
worst: Cells and Gauge sheet scatters parts (protection FETs, gate resistors, fuse, Q104, D101, caps) as islands tied only by labels, with dozens of auto-generated Net-(Uxxx-Pad) names and overlapping labels around U101/Q101

Very poor use of space: content packed into strips or corners with huge empty regions (3V3, MCU, Cells), while the USB sheet is so large the text is tiny; MCU antenna-match title runs off the sheet edge and the pi network is split apart
Long wandering wires and label-only connections around the BQ25756 charger and PD controller make datasheet checking require net tracing
